entries.notes: Basic program for all layers. Marek's: hatchery, day-old, subcutaneous (Rispens or Rispens/HVT preferred). Newcastle: live (water, spray or eye drop) where no velogenic ND; where velogenic ND is present, live eye drop plus inactivated injection together. Infectious bronchitis: 2-3 live doses, last by spray. Gumboro/IBD: live intermediate or intermediate-plus at days 15-18, 21-25 and 28-32, drinking water preferred. Fowl pox: 1-2 doses between 6 and 15 wk (water or wing-web); under 6 wk use highly attenuated or pigeon pox. Avian encephalomyelitis: 2 doses 4 wk apart. Ages not printed in the text are not stored.

standards.metric: vaccine:Fowl pox (6-15 wk window, first dose)

entries.notes: Use where disease is present: infectious coryza (2 doses 4 wk apart); fowl cholera live or inactivated (2 doses 4 wk apart); ILT (eye drop preferred; keep 7 days from other live respiratory vaccines); Mycoplasma gallisepticum (TS-11, 6/85 milder; F-strain stronger; bacterins available); Mycoplasma synoviae MS-H eye drop at 3-6 wk, MS-1 fine spray at 6+ wk; Salmonella 2-3 live doses then inactivated; E. coli live coarse spray 0-6 wk and again 12-14 wk; Egg drop syndrome one inactivated injection; avian pneumovirus; avian influenza inactivated (injected). Recombinant HVT vector vaccines (IBD, ND, ILT, H5) are given at the hatchery; do not combine two HVT-vectored vaccines.
